ORBITAL / FLIGHT MANUAL

Space rewards patience.

Explore a 3D Solar System with real orbital distances, inclined elliptical Kepler orbits, and gravity from the Sun and all eight planets. Drag to orbit the camera; scroll to zoom. Choose All planets for Neptune, or Follow ship for close flight.

P1: W forward thrust, A / D yaw, Q / E pitch. Both axes rotate freely through full loops.
P2: ↑ forward thrust, ← / → yaw, Page Up / Down pitch.
Space pauses. R resets. Short burns change your orbit. The ship has one forward engine: turn against your velocity and thrust to slow down.

Touch: hold a steering arrow and the thrust button together to steer while burning. Lift your finger to stop the input. Drag the view to orbit the camera; pinch to zoom. Tap Touch to show or hide controls. In two-pilot mode, choose which ship the touch controls steer. Landscape works best.

Ships start near Earth with its orbital velocity. Distances are AU, speeds km/s, and accelerations m/s². True sizes displays physical radii; planets can become smaller than a pixel.

Approximation: J2000 mean elements, fixed Kepler orbits (no planetary mutual perturbations), no moons, and no live ephemeris. Ships use 3D inverse-square gravity with velocity Verlet integration. Forecasts assume no thrust.
